text: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle is about more than just eating well. Of course, a balanced diet with plenty of fruits and vegetables gives your body the fuel it needs. Regular exercise, even a daily walk, keeps your heart strong and your muscles active. However, we often forget that rest and mental health are equally important. Getting enough sleep allows your body to recover, and taking time to relax helps reduce stress. Finally, remember the value of a healthy work-life balance. Setting boundaries between your job and personal time prevents burnout and brings more joy. In short, true health is a mix of a healthy body and a calm, satisfied mind.
